findings.title: AGENTS §2.5: five current safety statements still give inference-based figures as 'Calculation' or bare model output (unclamped J400 ESD 7.5 / 9.6 V in FMEA H-6 and REQUIREMENTS F9; C128's 991 microstrain in FMEA I-5; the fire budget in R10_VALIDATION §2; the 34.853 ms fault guard in R10_VALIDATION §5), so the round 28 status lines claiming every model figure resting on an inferred input is labelled are false
contradicts: AGENTS.md §2.5: 'An inference that has not been measured or checked against the original datasheet must be labelled as an inference, never written as fact.'

R28-TRI-09 (round28_triage.md): the label is required where the figure is stated; a place carrying 'Calculation' only (ORDERING:651) was part of that Major's fix list; the brief rates any AGENTS §2 violation Major.

The records' own classification of the same figures: M3_R10.md:456-457 '(Inference)' and ORDERING.md:651 'p7; Inference' for the unclamped 7.5 / 9.6 V; R10_VALIDATION.md:2534 '(Calculation/Inference)' and owner row 1 (line 2363) '(R21-SAF-03, Inference; §1)' for 991 microstrain; M3_R10.md:322 'Fire budget (Calculation / Inference)', REQUIREMENTS F7 '(Calc/Inference)', AGENTS.md:20 '1.279 A (conditional; Calculation / Inference)' for the fire currents; AGENTS.md:25 and binding-note obligation 7 'Calculation on allocations / Inference' for 34.853 ms.

D-R19-10 (R10_DECISIONS.md:2997): 'the X7R DC-bias loss there is taken as <= 6 % in the 0.72 x minimum (Inference: Samsung's curve not re-read)'; R23-SAFETY-06 (round23_safety.md:126): the 9.6 V is 'At C87's low bound'.

Status claims: AGENTS.md:32 '... and labelled every model figure that rests on an inferred input'; docs/M3_R10.md:33 (same) and :182 'every model figure resting on an inferred input labelled'; STATUS.md:18 'The fire-budget, EN-timing, hold-up, cold-screen and load-switch figures that rest on inferred inputs are now labelled Calculation / Inference.'
evidence: docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md:37 (H-6 row, ESD outcome (c)): 'the unclamped 7.5 V figure is nominal, the worst case is about 9.6 V (Calculation, against EN's 6.5 V absolute maximum)'. No Inference label anywhere in the row for this figure.

docs/REQUIREMENTS.md:64 (F9): 'Unclamped, a 150 pF / 8 kV contact discharge fully transferred into C87 would give about 7.5 V nominal on EN, about 9.6 V worst case, against its 6.5 V absolute maximum.' (no label) and '... these are not covered (R23-SAFETY-06, Calculation): ... (c) the unclamped 7.5 V figure is nominal C87 with J400 closed, and the worst case is about 9.6 V.' F9 nowhere names C87's inferred bias allowance.

Calculation (.supervisor/r29_safety/esd_calc.py -> esd_calc.out): 1.2 uC / 220 nF + 2.032 V = 7.487 V; 1.2 uC / (0.72 x 220 nF) + 2.063 V = 9.648 V ('about 9.6 V'); without the inferred 6 % DC-bias part (0.765 x) it is 9.193 V. The worst case therefore rests on the Inference D-R19-10 names, and on the full-transfer assumption.

docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md:38 (I-5 row): 'C128 (100 nF across Q124) is a second single-point route (a flex-crack short; 991 microstrain at 100 g, plate model).' No Calculation / Inference label; the same figure is '(Calculation/Inference)' at R10_VALIDATION.md:2534.

docs/R10_VALIDATION.md:2644-2647 (§2, current owner-acceptance detail): 'The 4.617803 ohm loop ... includes the stated hot copper/FET/contact/harness/source assumptions. On 50a39de5 ... a 7.4 V equivalent fire-time source gives 1.540851 A idle and 1.475765 / 1.410416 / 1.344761 / 1.278747 A at one to four persistent stalls' - no Calculation / Inference label; the fire budget's hot Q124 factor is an Inference (parts_qualification.md:490 'Calculation / Inference: Q124's inherited hot factor is an Inference'; m3_design/r10_parts.py:460 'inherited hot-factor inference').

docs/R10_VALIDATION.md:2711-2714 (§5, current): 'The intact-hardware watchdog allocation is 960 LSI cycles plus synchronization, reset and current tail, calculated 34.853 ms against 36 ms; the actual temperature/voltage/tail and watchdog implementation remain unmeasured.' The round 28 docs lane replaced exactly this '(calculated)' wording in AGENTS §1 with 'Calculation on allocations / Inference' (round28_fix_docs.md 'Siblings fixed'); R10_VALIDATION §5 kept it.

Same class outside the safety lens, relevant to the status claim: R10_VALIDATION.md:2404 (owner row 32) 'the 125 g at which the plate model puts C431 onto a 4 mm sled (C421 at 133 g; R25-TRI-10)' with no label, while ORDERING.md:702 and R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.md:107 label the same figure Calculation/Inference.

Sweep method: python context scan of every current statement of the fire-budget currents, hold-up, cold-screen, Q122-drive, plate-model, EN/C87, ESD and watchdog-guard figures in AGENTS, STATUS, M3_R10, REQUIREMENTS, ORDERING, FMEA, R10_VALIDATION (current sections 2350-3031) and the handoff (.supervisor/r29_safety/labelscan.py); every other hit is labelled at sentence, bullet, row or section level.
findings.impact: Four safety documents present inferred safety figures (the fire-current margin over the 1.125 A floor, the watchdog fault-current guard, the EN overstress after an ESD at the arming switch, the strain driving C128's single-point fire route) as calculated fact, against AGENTS §2.5, while other documents label the identical figures Inference; the round 28 status lines in AGENTS, M3_R10 and STATUS claim the sweep is complete. No board, fab-package or hardware impact.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only, no board change. FMEA:37 (c): '(Calculation / Inference: a full transfer of the 150 pF / 8 kV charge into C87 is assumed, and the 9.6 V uses C87's 0.72 x minimum, whose <= 6 % X7R DC-bias part is an Inference, D-R19-10; against EN's 6.5 V absolute maximum)'. REQUIREMENTS F9: add the same label after '... against its 6.5 V absolute maximum' and change '(R23-SAFETY-06, Calculation)' to '(R23-SAFETY-06, Calculation / Inference)'. FMEA:38: '991 microstrain at 100 g, plate model, Calculation / Inference'. R10_VALIDATION:2646: after the currents add '(Calculation / Inference: Q124's inherited hot factor is an Inference, and the FET, R134 hot, harness, contact and converter-load figures are unmeasured allowances)'. R10_VALIDATION:2714: 'calculated 34.853 ms' -> '34.853 ms (Calculation on allocations / Inference: the 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.5 ms allocations need bench tests, and the gate-discharge model's 0.4 V off criterion and hot gate charge are inferred)'. Also label owner row 32's plate-model 125 / 133 g, and either sweep the rest of R10_VALIDATION §2-§13 for model figures (e.g. §4's hot-plug row) or narrow the AGENTS:32 / M3_R10:33, :182 / STATUS:18 claims to the scope actually swept.

observations: Rule 3's ground refusal says 'a QSPI quad read-verify of a known pattern'; the source (round23_safety_severity_check.md) specified a known all-ones region at the default 25 % DRV: at 100 % drive the fight level (about 1.9 V, Inference) lies between VIL and VIH, and rule 3 forbids 100 % only 'while PC1 is high'. Clarity of a firmware obligation, labelled inference in the same rule; not counted.

Q124.4 to Q124.5 (gate to own drain, F.Cu) is 0.520 mm: a bridge there self-biases Q124 into conduction (OUT = gate; roughly 1.2-1.5 A through an enabled match, Inference), the OUT-to-lower-potential class; §1 lists the gap without the consequence; considered by the round 25 triage.

PYRO1_OUT-to-GND approaches under 0.5 mm besides the named 0.177 / 0.180 / 0.500 mm: 0.237 mm (B.Cu (11.63,55.1)-(10.37,56.36) to the GND via (10.3,55.6)), 0.325 mm (B.Cu run to C128.2), 0.414 / 0.467 mm; all in the disclosed OUT-to-GND class, whose minima the records name.

PYRO1_OUT to BUZZ_G 0.510 mm (R173.1 to the B.Cu run at x 17.75): behind R162 1 kOhm / R163 10 kOhm an enabled bus passes at most about 8.4 mA through the match; no fire; the cold screen refuses; benign and not listed.
ACT_GATE to BAT_IN 0.2177 mm (B.Cu (14.475,72.2)-(15.262,72.987) to Q120.9): a bridge holds both P-FETs off (fail-safe); the powered-BUS ground refusal catches it.

U9-bypass adjacencies re-measured unchanged on a0ec075e (U9.5-U9.6 0.200 mm; J1.1's In2 ring and the BAT_IN via (17.5,87.15) barrel 0.2505 mm from In2 RAW_PROTECTED): already ruled (R25-SAFETY obs 3).
Further I-5 routes at 0.2505 mm via-barrel-to-fill clearance: 3V3 via (26.4,79.26) to In2 RAW_PROTECTED, CAM_5V via (34.2,49.325) to In2 3V3; the I-5 lists say 'include' (round 27 ruling).

FMEA I-5 quotes 132.0 / 35.9 / 34.6 mm (In2 3V3 fill edge within 0.6 mm of RAW_PROTECTED / PORT_5V3 / PORT_4V8) without naming 0dc84776, where R10_VALIDATION §1 measured them; 5 um sampling on a0ec075e gives 138.3 / 35.8 / 34.8 mm (method may differ); the 0.300 mm minimum is unchanged.

R10_VALIDATION §1's J440.1 / J440.2-to-J121.1 harness row puts J440.1 (PORT_4V8) in the OUT-to-GND class that 'fires an enabled match by itself'; the LDO cannot sink, so the match current equals the port load (about 0.1-0.55 A) until the rail rises: firing possible, not certain. Conservative overstatement, not counted.

Rule 4's 0.96 band is load-dependent: with camera and ports at full load VLOGIC sits about 0.2 V below BAT_IN, so a Q120-off board can read near 0.96 (Inference); 'Qualify the band on first articles' covers it.
Rule 4's '0.93-1.01x the 1.125 A floor' spans R23's whole case set (1.043-1.137 A), not only the quoted 1.128 / 1.063 A (0.945-1.003x); already ruled conservative (R27-MCU obs 5).
Rule 3's 47-53 us gate time constant is C126 at -10 % to nominal (source), not +10 %; within the labelled Calculation / Simulation sentence.

REQUIREMENTS F6 and owner row 21 quote the 1.095 / 1.028 / 1.025 V chatter trains without an adjacent label, but in a cell / row that labels the same EN model's X7R allowance an Inference (ORDERING:620 labels them); judged covered.
The S-8 tables' J400.2 'In1 GND 0.250 since D-R20-05' is 0.5505 mm on a0ec075e after D-R21-01 (labelled history; R25-SAFETY obs).
The rule 3 first-article meter criterion has no verdict for readings of 100-900 Ohm; R10_VALIDATION §1 says above 0.9 kOhm passes; wording, not counted.

AGENTS §2.1-§2.4 hold on a0ec075e: RAW_ACT is fed only through Q121 (the forward blocking device; Q120's body diode conducts BAT_IN to ACT_FET_S), Q124 has R126 220 Ohm series, R128 10 k / R127 1 k pull-downs and C126 220 nF gate-source; Q120 / Q121 have R121 10 k series, R119 / R120 100 k gate-source and C120 1 uF; Q122 has R122 1 k, R123 2 k and C123 10 nF; all fitted in the JLC BOM and CPL.

Per-flight steps 1-7 are consistent with the circuit: step 2's J121.2 < 0.1 V (IDSS <= 5 uA x 11.2 k <= 56 mV); step 3 is the only screen of the three PC1 / bus latch pairs (no other BAT_ENABLE neighbour within 1.25 mm is energised only with the bus enabled); CONT equals BUS through the dummy; step 4's meter sees about 22 kOhm in parallel with the match.

Rule 4's probe topology is right: Q120.4, C120.2 and R120.2 share one B.Cu island that reaches R121.1 only through the vias (16.2,73.3) / (15.4,72.85); Q121.4 and R119.1 likewise through (11.14,71.7) / (11.74,72.3).

coverage_limits: No physical, bench or firmware test; no re-run of the QSPI fight simulation, the plate model, the fire budget, the EN chatter model or the hot-plug model (their figures were checked against their sources and by hand recomputation where noted).

Zone fills are the ones saved in the committed board (not refilled); polygon chords make each distance an upper bound within 0.5 um, so sub-micron differences from the records' KiCad shape distances are not judged.

The §2.5 sweep targeted safety figures (fire budget, fault guard, EN / C87 model, ESD, hold-up, cold screen, Q122 drive, C128 strain); non-safety model figures were only sampled (owner row 32, §4's hot-plug row), and parts_qualification.md was not swept (audit lane A covered it).
Historical sections (R10_VALIDATION lines below 2350 and above 3031, M3_R10 board history, decision records) were read as history and not judged for labels.
tools/check.sh, DRC and the build were not run on the canonical tree (read-only brief); other lenses' round 29 reports were not opened.
